chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about the Jewish woman and the Christian woman, can the man marry her upon (as an additional wife) the Muslim woman? He (peace be upon him) said: No, and he can marry the Muslim woman upon the Jewish woman and the Christian woman.

key_terms.يَتَزَوَّجُهَا عَلَى: Marry her upon (as an additional wife)

ai.seo_question: Can a Muslim man marry a Jewish or Christian woman if he is already married to a Muslim woman?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the asymmetry in polygyny rules by establishing that a man cannot marry a Jewish or Christian woman while already married to a Muslim woman, but he can marry a Muslim woman while already married to a Jewish or Christian woman. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of the hierarchy of marital status, prioritizing the Muslim wife's status over that of the Ahl al-Kitab wife. It serves as a practical legal guideline for maintaining family structure and religious integrity within mixed-faith households.
